# ============================================================
#  HOMEPAGE FIX:  /  ->  index.php
#  Server ka apna DirectoryIndex kaam nahi kar raha tha, isliye
#  document root (/) par 500 aa raha tha jabki /index.php 200 deti thi.
#  Yahan explicitly bata rahe hain ki / par kya serve karna hai.
# ============================================================
DirectoryIndex index.php index.html

<ifModule mod_gzip.c>
mod_gzip_on Yes
mod_gzip_dechunk Yes
mod_gzip_item_include file .(html?|txt|css|js|php|pl)$
mod_gzip_item_include handler ^cgi-script$
mod_gzip_item_include mime ^text/.*
mod_gzip_item_include mime ^application/x-javascript.*
mod_gzip_item_exclude mime ^image/.*
mod_gzip_item_exclude rspheader ^Content-Encoding:.*gzip.*
</ifModule>
<FilesMatch "\.(html|css)$">
  Header set Cache-Control "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0"
</FilesMatch>
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    Header set Cache-Control "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate"
    Header set Pragma "no-cache"
    Header set Expires 0
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_expires.c>
  ExpiresActive On
  ExpiresByType text/html A0
  ExpiresByType text/css A0
  ExpiresByType application/javascript A0
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    Header unset X-Powered-By
</IfModule>
# ============================================================
#  Rewrite engine — sabse pehle, aur sirf EK baar
# ============================================================
RewriteEngine On

# 404 handler. NOTE: /404.php server par MAUJOOD honi chahiye,
# warna har missing URL 500 dega (yahi bug tha).
ErrorDocument 404 /404.php

# Force www  (dot escape kiya: ^www\. )
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^www\. [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://www.fsia.in/$1 [R=301,L]

# Homepage: khali path (/) ko index.php par bhejo.
# ^$ SIRF / par match karta hai - baaki 8076 slug rules par koi asar nahi.
# Loop nahi banega: rewrite ke baad path 'index.php' ho jata hai, jo ^$ se match nahi karta.
# Force-www ke BAAD rakha hai, taaki non-www / pehle www par 301 ho.
RewriteRule ^$ index.php [L]

# /file.php/extra-junk  ->  /file.php
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^(.*\.php)/.*$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ %1 [L,R=301]

# HATAYA GAYA: purana catch-all block
#   RewriteCond $1 [A-Z]
#   RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
#   RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
#   RewriteRule ^.*$ /index.php [L]
# Ye kabhi chalta hi nahi tha ($1 khali tha, rule me capture group nahi).
# ISE "THEEK" MAT KARNA - capture group add karoge to har request
# index.php par chali jayegi aur poori site toot jayegi.
